what_this_shows: One account's 1,763 daily returns over 85 months (2016-02 to 2023-02, 4 blank days) were strung into months and checked: 82 months match Commonwealth's reported monthly figure within 0.05 points, none differ, and 3 are ungradable (2 blank-day months whose reported monthly figure is also absent, and 1 month with no reported monthly figure). The strung figures equal the served computed_pct in all 85 months (83 present and equal, 2 with both absent), and the reported figures are readable beside the days for 82 months (monthly), 84 (yearly) and 85 (since-inception), with benchmark counts of 82, 84 and 85.
not_established: This is one account of 1,533 (85 of 82,593 months, 0.10 percent of the table's months), and it is not representative of the table: its blank share is 4 of 1,763 days (0.2 percent) against 1,584,413 of 1,691,729 table days (93.7 percent), and its MATCH share is 82 of 85 months (96.5 percent) against 3,678 of 82,593 table months (4.5 percent). The served month_grades table holds 5 month rows whose verdict is null (neither MATCH, DIFF nor UNGRADABLE), which the population counts above do not include. The 'both absent' months are counted as equal per the order's item 3(a); the issuer's recompute counts present-and-equal only (83), a definitional difference filed as a channel row. The account's span is 2016-02 to 2023-02, not the table's 2013-04 start. The order's FWD-3 is not graded here.
